note: Campground on the Bledsoe Creek arm of Old Hickory Lake. Premium sites 53-57 on the shoreline loop and A-E look to the lake through trees; 57 has a drop-off near its living area. Rabbit Jump Road (sites 22-34) takes no tow vehicle and trailer longer than 30 ft in all. --Claude
summary: TN State Parks campground confirmed: 65 sites (stored 68) + 3 hammock, 50-amp + water (13 sites 30-amp, 12 of them 20 ft), no sewer, dump, laundry, showers; $32-70 incl. holidays (stored $32-46). Lakefront DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE to lakeview (pads ~45 m back under trees). Old construction caveat (through summer 2026) expired and dropped.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE (stored value not --AWH; its evidence itself said 'canopy-screened ... defer to per-site authority'): the nearest-water sites are premium 53-57 on the shoreline loop (engine: 53/54/57 'located close to the water'; TN Parks' waterfront article names 55-57). RVs on that road at about 36.3758,-86.3576 and 36.3753,-86.3574 stand 2.2-3.1 m above Old Hickory's 445-ft summer pool with the water's edge 42-48 m away (3DEP), across a continuous wooded shore band (Esri) that the operator's own photos of 53 and 57 show as open woods with the lake seen through the trunks. At ~45 m under canopy that is a view, not on-water. A-E ('waterfront sites have beautiful views of the lake') and 8 ('waterfront view') are further back. All are ordinary nightly sites ($40-47).

SITES: 65 campsites on the engine (stored 68, probably counting the three hike-in hammock sites; no 20 or 35). Sites 23-34 are 20 ft (under 23 ft) on 30-amp; 22 is 56 ft, also 30-amp, $32-35 = the base for a 23-ft rig. The park page's '34 paved and 5 gravel' 50-amp sites and '14' 30-amp do not match the engine's 52/13; max_rig_ft from the engine.

SEASON: no campground season statement (the page says the dump and laundromat are 'available year-round'); the engine prices every 50-amp site on most January 2027 nights while the 30-amp sites are unavailable then. Stored year_round left as is.

PIN: stored 36.3782,-86.3573 lies at the north end of the campground road, ~150-200 m from the loops' centre (~36.3765,-86.3570); not a >250 m move. Google's park pin 36.3784,-86.3606 is ~300 m west (park, not campground).

Phone 615-452-3706 (Visitor Center & Gift Shop) confirmed; websites unchanged. Status operating; the old note's 'Construction ongoing through Summer 2026' is past its own date and the park page shows no such notice, so it was dropped. The rest of the old note restated the state:TN booking row and the fields.
